title: Explore with a question
summary: Exploratory testing uses a goal and careful observation. You choose the next step from what you discover.
introduction: Exploratory testing uses a goal and careful observation. You choose the next step from what you discover. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Exploratory testing uses a goal and careful observation. You choose the next step from what you discover.

blocks.code:
Goal: can I use the search with only a keyboard?
Try: Tab to search, type a word, press Enter
Record: focus order, result, unexpected behaviour
blocks.title: Explore with a question

blocks.text: The exploration has a clear purpose and written observations.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explore what happens when search has no matches.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Random clicking without notes makes useful findings hard to repeat.
For more detail later, use this [Software Testing further reading](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Extensions/Testing).
